verdict.rationale: Letta's pricing page (docs.letta.com/pricing) is referenced with concrete tier details — a free tier capped at 'Up to 20 stateful agents' and a Pro plan offering remote sandboxes, usage quota, and purchasable credits — showing a real tiered pricing structure exists. However, no evidence shows explicit per-unit rates (e.g., $/credit, $/GB-memory, $/agent-hour) needed to project memory costs precisely. Missing for 10: published per-unit/credit pricing rates, memory-storage cost breakdown, and any calculator or cost-estimation tooling.
